summary: AnyCable is a backend server designed to handle persistent, real-time connections using protocols like WebSockets and Server-Sent Events. It allows applications to manage high volumes of concurrent bidirectional data streams without overwhelming traditional application servers.
goodFor: It suits systems that need to scale concurrent real-time connections beyond the typical capacity of standard web frameworks.
watchOut: Running a dedicated socket server adds architectural complexity and requires careful capacity planning for persistent memory and connection states.
deployNotes: As a Go application packaged for containers, you will typically run it behind a reverse proxy handling TLS and couple it with an external message broker like Redis for inter-process communication.
